headline: CDBG Priority Setting Task Force approves revised application questions, scoring, and financial stability rules for grant process
summary: The task force reviewed and revised CDBG application questions, scoring categories, and requirements across sections including Experience Providing Service, Measurable Community Impact, Readiness to Proceed, Financial Stability, and Strategic Partnerships. The committee approved updated wording and point allocations for these sections and discussed how to present the final report to City Council.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.
Approved updated wording for Question 1 in the Experience Providing Service section.
Approved updated wording for Question 2 in Experience Providing Service regarding data collection systems.
Approved Question 1 in Measurable Community Impact as written.
Approved Question 2 in Measurable Community Impact with an amendment for city staff to link to resources within the application.
Reallocated the 5 remaining points in Measurable Community Impact, giving 3 points to Question 1 and 2 points to Question 2.
Approved modified wording for Question 1 in Readiness to Proceed.
Approved Question 2 in Readiness to Proceed to require uploading a timeline instead of a descriptive narrative.
Approved Question 3 in Readiness to Proceed addressing barriers and how the organization plans to overcome them.
Approved a motion for staff to wordsmith the Financial Stability requirements to include Form 990s, the most recent 6 months of financials, and audited statements.
Approved splitting the Strategic Partnerships section into two 3-point questions with helper text.
